Draft code for these adapters exists uncommitted in the arrow-result-fetch-2 member 2 worktree. Check whether it was kept or discarded. It covers: MotherDuck; Databricks; Athena; ClickHouse Cloud query_arrow; BigQuery via the Storage read API, with the storage extra; and Snowflake.

Open issue found there: fetch_mode option forwarding did not reach the Databricks and BigQuery configs in a dry run.

Contract (owner, 2026-11-06): full receipt inside the timer, a fetch_mode field, and comparison within one mode only.

Guardrails: no live-cloud run without owner approval quoted in context; an adapter stays on rows by default until its parity run passes; work in a linked worktree; no explanatory comments; changelog fragment.
